respuesta.razonamiento: Merged visual and spoken readings for a multi-account/multi-VPC CI/CD architecture. Dev is matched to UserCompanyDeveloper. Visual box b2 (CODEPIPELINE) and b5 (# 100 1.) Change Set 2.) Approve 3.) Execute) are fused into a single CodePipeline node representing the pipeline and its 100 deployment action stages. Visual box b6 (REGISTRY) is identified as Amazon ECR based on the spoken narration. Visual container c0 (VPC) contains ECS, IAM, and ALB; following Edge Rule 1, the drawn deployment line from CloudFormation to c0 is expanded into parallel deployment edges to ECS, IAM, and ALB, as explicitly confirmed by the narration.
respuesta.nombre: Multi-VPC Deployment Pipeline with AWS CodePipeline and CloudFormation
